general.description: Core MPD configuration including paths, user, network, and logging. This init script section only supports overriding MPDCONF via environment variable (not directly configurable in this init script). For full configuration, edit /etc/mpd.conf or set environment variable MPDCONF before starting the service.

mpd.conf_path.description: Path to the MPD main configuration file (used by init script via MPDCONF variable).
